clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire demands proof that Dextren Ward has been executed in the Stormwind Stockade. The severed hand is bound for town, where grieving families await justice for their dead.

Dextren Ward was sentenced to death by Lord Ebonlocke after he was caught digging up bodies in Duskwood cemeteries and selling them to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Stormwind intervened before the town could execute him and took him to the Stockade. For Darkshire's grieving families, Ward's hand proves the defiler has been executed, despite the House of Nobles' unwanted leniency.
